papers.summary: This case study presents IF: CARGO, an experimental puzzle game that uses a large language model as a semantic compiler rather than an autonomous game-playing agent. Players author IF/THEN rules in natural language, which the model translates into a constrained command schema for deterministic validation and execution by the game engine. This architecture creates a playable loop of expression, execution, observation, and revision, framing AI interaction as semantic debugging. papers.title: Geometric Transformations and Symmetry in the Panjunan Red Mosque, Cirebon: An Ethnomathematical Study for Culture-Based Geometry Learning
papers.summary: Historic mosques in Indonesia embody mathematical ideas, yet studies of the Panjunan Red Mosque in Cirebon, built in 1480, have focused on its history and cultural acculturation rather than its mathematical structure. This study aims to identify and map the plane geometry, solid geometry, and geometric transformations embodied in the architecture of the mosque as a source of contextual mathematics learning. papers.title: A fragile reversible watermarking technique for medical imaging security using prediction error expansion and Canny edge detection
papers.summary: This paper develops a fragile, reversible watermarking technique to detect accidental and intentional alterations in DICOM medical images. A fragile method is adopted to detect any manipulation applied to medical images, while reversibility ensures the recovery of the original unaltered image at extraction. The proposed approach automatically segments medical images into Region of Interest (ROI) and Region of Non-Interest (RONI), extracts authentication data from the DICOM header, and generates a digital signature of the image. papers.title: Critique of Anthropocentrism in The Water-Babies
papers.summary: The Victorian era marked the zenith of the British Industrial Revolution, yet it also gave rise to a series of environmental crises and social problems. Taking The Water-Babies as its object of inquiry, this paper employs the method of close reading and, centering on the critique of anthropocentrism, examines the anthropocentric values embodied in and criticized by this work. It further argues that the work can provide a paradigm for cultivating children's ecological personhood and offer significant literary insights for realizing the harmonious coexistence of humanity and nature.
